name: Max
summary: A humanoid prototype Meta reportedly built with China's Fourier, about 1.5 m and 48 kg with NVIDIA Jetson Thor compute, with a second version under way. It was reported by The Information in November 2026 and has not been shown by Meta; it signals Meta's move from robotics research software into its own hardware.

sources.title: Meta Reportedly Built 'Max' Humanoid With Fourier — Humanoids Daily
Meta built humanoid prototype with Chinese startup — The Information
